text:
leah (Marketing): Final check-in for tomorrow's benchmark + playbook launch. Goal: go-live 10:00 PT, embargoed briefing at 09:50 PT. Need final thumbs on press kit, visuals, and incident monitoring.

sam (PR): Have the reporter list ready. Will send embargo email 09:50 PT. Reminder: personalize subject for top-tier outlets.

nina (Growth): Paid and organic schedules queued. I'll hold 15% extra budget for the first 30 mins in case of underdelivery. Tracking params: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_2026.

emma (Design): Last call on hero and social cards. Uploaded final hero and 3 crop variants: https://drive.redwood/benchmark/hero-final. Minor color tweak requested by brand; applied.

leah (Marketing): Good. @carmen legal had a request yesterday about partner mentions?

carmen (Legal): Yes. Please remove partner logos from the press kit and any visuals until we get written permission. We can include partner names in the body if they already agreed, but not logos.

sam (PR): Roger. I'll strip logos from attachments. Also: embargo instructions in email header, and a one-paragraph embargo note in the attached PDF.

ryan (Support): Support will staff 09:4511:45 PT with two triage engineers and one senior on-call. Will add a short FAQ to the kit. Please include expected customer questions e.g., "Will my latency change?" and "How do I enable caching?"

raj (Product): We'll publish a small tutorial alongside the blog. Deployment tested in staging; no breaking changes. We'll monitor tokengateway latency during the window.

ops-bot: scheduled probe: site-health check at 09:58 PT; alert if 5xx > 0 for 2 consecutive checks.

leah (Marketing): Social plan: 10:01 PT announcement, 12:00 PT deep thread, 15:30 PT customer quote. @nina can you confirm GIF sizes?

nina (Growth): GIFs set for 1:1 and 16:9. We'll also test preview cards on X and LinkedIn at 09:55 PT.

emma (Design): GIFs live in drive/gifs/benchmark. Use 1200x630 for LinkedIn and 800x800 for IG.

sam (PR): Quick question: who is on the record for quotes? I have CTO, head of research, and raj for product details. Which quotes are cleared?

carmen (Legal): CTO quote pre-cleared. Head of research quote pending a minor edit to remove a comparative statement. Raj's product quote is fine.

leah (Marketing): Use CTO for opener, raj for technical paragraph, research quote as long-form if approved by EOD.

sam (PR): Will prepare embargo attachments: 1) embargoed blog PDF, 2) summary chart PNGs (no raw CSV), 3) press FAQ. No raw bench data in the pack.

ryan (Support): Can you add a short "How we measured" blurb so we can answer methodology questions quickly?

leah (Marketing): Good idea. @sam add a one-paragraph methodology note.

sam (PR): Added. Also flagging: do not send embargo to Outlet Z; we have separate exclusive outreach next week.

carmen (Legal): Confirmed, Outlet Z excluded. Also check any quotes that mention customer names  those need approvals.

ops-bot: reminder posted: monitoring dashboard link will be posted to #marketing-ops at 09:59 PT.

leah (Marketing): Final timeline recap: 09:40 PT internal heads-up to execs; 09:50 PT send embargoed materials to approved reporters; 09:58 PT smoke tests + preview checks; 10:00 PT lift embargo and publish blog + press release; 10:01 PT social live. Everyone copy me on any delays.

emma (Design): I'll be on-call for quick edits until 11:00 PT.

raj (Product): I'll be watching infra metrics and ready to toggle fallback if needed.

ryan (Support): Slack channel #support-monitoring will be cleared for triage. Pager escalation steps confirmed.

leah (Marketing): Thanks. Emoji roll call: :rocket: :white_check_mark: :eyes:

sam (PR): :white_check_mark: prepping embargo mail

nina (Growth): :rocket: ad queues ready

leah (Marketing): All set. If nothing else, see you tomorrow morning for the launch window.
